name: Schneider connectivity robustness
formula: R = sum_{Q=1}^N LCC(Q) / N^2; original N; excludes Q=0; includes empty Q=N
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Full single-node undirected trajectory, N>0. Requires largest_component_size. Does not silently generalize to edge attacks or directed graphs.

name: Lou node-removal control robustness
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Full single-node path, N>0; supplied structural_driver_count or exact_numeric_driver_count retains its system and general-input model; lower is more robust.

name: Lou edge-removal control robustness
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Full single-edge path, N>0, M=0 permitted. Counts and input model must be valid; lower is more robust.

name: Trapezoidal area of observed scalar curve
definition: Trapezoidal area of observed scalar curve
formula: sum_j (x[j+1]-x[j])*(y[j+1]+y[j])/2 on actual observed fractions; optional y/y(0)
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Observed interval endpoints required; missing values invalidate integral; repeated identical positions deduplicated; no extrapolation. Initial normalization undefined when y(0)=0. metric_parameters optionally selects exact normalized source parameters; empty requires an unambiguous metric ID.

name: First observed threshold crossing fraction
formula: min observed x with y<=threshold (or y>=threshold)
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Reports first observed crossing only; batch gaps are not interpolated. Not reached is undefined with reached=false; unavailable earlier observations are not_computed. metric_parameters optionally selects exact normalized source parameters; empty requires an unambiguous metric ID.

name: Efficiency relative to initial efficiency
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory supplied by mc.summarize. Initial efficiency must be finite and nonzero; retains per-step masks; no clipping to [0,1].

name: Edge and directed connectivity full-path robustness
definition: Original-population-normalized largest weak/strong component summed after every deletion; undirected node removal uses robustness_schneider.
formula: R_mode = sum_{q=1}^{T0} L_mode(q)/(T0*N0), T0=M0 for edge removal or N0 for directed node removal; excludes q=0, includes q=T0
source_version: Zeng and Liu arXiv:1203.2982v1 (2012), Eq. (1); verified 2026-09-28. Its adaptive highest-edge-betweenness attack is not imposed on user protocols.
license: Original implementation from cited mathematics; no third-party source code copied
complexity: O(T) time and space for T observed states
conditions: Runtime trajectory via mc.summarize; all counts 0:T0, N0>0,T0>0; undirected edge uses weak; directed weak/strong explicit. No coarse-grid substitution or initial-component normalization. Final edge state retains all N0 nodes and L=1. Node-only undirected delegates to existing Schneider metric.
